fields.Alternative: Restrict the configuration, alter a justified constraint or use a simpler compatible implementation; do not require a larger matrix as the remedy.
fields.Novelty: No new property: current C104 and applicable actual-product/contract criteria already demand checking the relevant joint premises.
fields.Question: Can pairwise-valid constraints still lack a joint realization?
fields.Removal: Removing any one toy constraint restores two assignments; that establishes the higher-order inconsistency of this construction.

fields.Alternative: A single small accurate graph or direct reasoning can replace three tools; copying all graphs is not required.
fields.Novelty: No new property: full C025 impact analysis already includes known consequential propagation.
fields.Question: Can a consequential dependency path cross three independently stored representations?
fields.Removal: Removing a needed bridge makes the local traversal miss the supported variant; the full path must be justified, not assumed from similarly named nodes.

fields.Alternative: Source custody, a documented emulator or a narrower historical explanation can be adequate alternatives to live operation.
fields.Case: Preservation cases PRES-C01–PRES-C05 and frontier SSS-FR-C01/SSS-FR-C04; full results remain in their exact source files.

fields.Question: Does joining variant identity, runtime environment and historical purpose create a new preservation law?
fields.Removal: Omitting a context needed by the declared observation loses that warrant; if the consumer only needs source identity, that context may be inapplicable.

fields.Alternative: One directly verified shared object can eliminate expensive synchronization among redundant accounts.

fields.Question: Can accurate individual records still fail a common support or preservation decision?
fields.Removal: Remove an irrelevant branch without loss; remove an actually relied-on correspondence and the joint warrant fails.

fields.Alternative: No change, one repair, a maintained clone, selective reuse, consolidation or explicit retirement can win under different premises.

fields.Question: Does jointly comparing architecture, support and product-family cost force product-line adoption?
fields.Removal: An inapplicable family mechanism can be omitted; ignoring a material cost can reverse the comparison.

fields.Alternative: Use an advisory analysis, a bounded subset or an already authorised operational process.

fields.Question: Can local model correctness justify global progress or operational authority?
fields.Removal: An adequately narrow formal claim can remain valid when the global claim is withheld; absence of a plant/authority bridge does not refute its theorem.

fields.Question: Does the combined corpus establish open-ended autonomous evolution or superior regeneration?
fields.Removal: Removing one asserted general capability does not erase validated bounded assistance; it does remove any claim that the whole autonomous bundle has been established.

fields.Alternative: An adequate current register or a directly checked small product can replace the discovery/lookup route; a legitimately narrower claim can avoid an inapplicable obligation.
fields.Novelty: No new property. Full sampling already requires critical known combinations and valid relevant scope; the realization/discovery criteria supply inputs. The names of three lineage mechanisms are not three universally necessary normative principles.
fields.Question: Can discovery, realization and a critical-risk rule jointly change the sampling obligation without establishing a new property?
fields.Removal: The construction separately removes discovery, realization and risk; it records missing premises rather than silently imputing them.
